capabilities.name: Remove Background
capabilities.description: Removes the background from one photo and returns the subject on a transparent background as a PNG, at the photo's own size.

input.description: Give exactly one of image_url or image_base64. The same request body must be sent again with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header.

image_url.description: A public https URL of a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.

output.description: The subject on a transparent background, same width and height as the input.

capabilities.name: Web Image Optimizer
capabilities.description: Resizes one image so its longest side is at most max_width pixels (never enlarging it) and encodes it as WebP at the given quality. Transparency is kept. Metadata is not carried over, so a JPEG's EXIF orientation is not applied.

input.description: Give exactly one of image_url or image_base64. The same request body must be sent again with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header.

image_url.description: A public https URL of a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.

max_width.description: Longest side of the output, in pixels.

output.description: A WebP no larger than max_width on its longest side.
